records.question: Mobil qurilmaning IMEI-kodini qanday bilish mumkin?
question_variants: Mobil qurilmaning IMEI-kodini qanday bilish mumkin
records.answer: Qurilma klaviaturasida *#06# kombinatsiyasini tering. IMEI-kod qurilma qutisi, kafolat hujjati yoki ayrim modellarda batareya ostida ham ko‘rsatilishi mumkin.

official_sources.note: The current page gives *#06# and identifies the box, warranty document, and battery area as additional locations.

records.question: IMEI-kod holatini qanday tekshirish mumkin?
question_variants: IMEI-kod holatini qanday tekshirish mumkin
records.answer: IMEI holatini UZIMEI saytida, 1170 qisqa raqamiga SMS yuborish yoki *1170# USSD so‘rovi orqali tekshirish mumkin.

official_sources.note: The current RTMC FAQ supports the stated low-risk IMEI or MNP fact.

records.question: IMEI-kodni ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishning qanday usullari mavjud?
question_variants: IMEI-kodni ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishning qanday usullari mavjud
records.answer: Joriy UZIMEI ko‘rsatmalarida Birda va MyGov ilovalari, USSD/SMS, UZIMEI operatori hamda pochta nuqtalari orqali ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish usullari ko‘rsatilgan. Har bir usulning amaldagi talablarini UZIMEI sahifasida tekshiring.

official_sources.note: The current page lists Birda, MyGov, USSD/SMS, UZIMEI operator, and postal registration methods.

records.question: Shaxsiy foydalanish uchun olib kirilgan mobil qurilma deklaratsiya qilinadimi?
question_variants: Shaxsiy foydalanish uchun olib kirilgan mobil qurilma deklaratsiya qilinadimi
records.answer: Shaxsiy foydalanish uchun olib kiriladigan mobil qurilma yo‘lovchi bojxona deklaratsiyasida ko‘rsatilishi va uning IMEI-kodi amaldagi bojxona hamda UZIMEI tartibiga muvofiq qayd etilishi kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — New procedure for registering mobile-device IMEI codes
official_sources.note: The current RTMC notice describes declaration of personally imported devices and integrated customs-to-UZIMEI registration.

records.question: IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda abonent raqami kimning nomida bo‘lishi kerak?
question_variants: IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda abonent raqami kimning nomida bo‘lishi kerak
records.answer: Ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda foydalaniladigan mahalliy abonent raqami ariza beruvchining nomiga rasmiylashtirilgan bo‘lishi kerak.

official_sources.section: Applicant phone number and identity information
official_sources.note: The current page requires the local subscriber number to be registered to the applicant and describes identity fields.

records.question: Pochta yoki kuryer orqali olingan qurilmaning IMEI-kodi qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladi?
question_variants: Pochta yoki kuryer orqali olingan qurilmaning IMEI-kodi qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladi
records.answer: Ariza beruvchi pasporti, qurilma va shu pasportga rasmiylashtirilgan mahalliy SIM-karta bilan shaxsan murojaat qiladi. Pochta jo‘natmasi uchun muhrlangan qoplama yoki konvert ham talab qilinadi.

official_sources.note: The current page describes in-person postal registration, same-identity SIM ownership, and the stamped package requirement.

records.question: Norezident IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda nimalarga e’tibor berishi kerak?
question_variants: Norezident IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda nimalarga e’tibor berishi kerak
records.answer: Norezident amaldagi UZIMEI usullaridan foydalanishi va mahalliy SIM-kartani o‘z nomiga norezident maqomida rasmiylashtirishi kerak. Ushbu yozuv ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish muddati haqida xulosa bermaydi.

official_sources.note: The current page lists Birda, MyGov, USSD/SMS, UZIMEI operator, and postal registration methods.

records.question: O‘zbekistonda telefon sotib olishdan oldin IMEI bo‘yicha nima tekshiriladi?
question_variants: O‘zbekistonda telefon sotib olishdan oldin IMEI bo‘yicha nima tekshiriladi
records.answer: Sotuv uchun olib kirilgan qurilmaning IMEI-kodi import qiluvchi tomonidan ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazilgan bo‘lishi kerak. Xaridor qurilma kodlarini *#06# orqali aniqlab, qutidagi kodlar bilan solishtirishi va UZIMEI orqali holatini tekshirishi kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — Check the IMEI code before buying a phone
official_sources.note: The current RTMC notice places registration responsibility on importing businesses and tells purchasers to check IMEI status.

records.question: Qurilmada bir nechta IMEI-kod bo‘lishi nimani anglatadi?
question_variants: Qurilmada bir nechta IMEI-kod bo‘lishi nimani anglatadi
records.answer: Departament FAQiga ko‘ra, ikki yoki undan ortiq IMEI-kod qurilma bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta SIM-karta va mobil tarmoq xizmatidan foydalana olishini anglatishi mumkin. Joriy rasmiy tasdiq kutilmoqda.

official_sources.note: The accessible current page does not confirm this specific departmental procedure; human source review remains required.

records.question: Ro‘yxatdan o‘tmagan IMEI sabab bloklangan qurilma bo‘yicha nima qilish kerak?
question_variants: Ro‘yxatdan o‘tmagan IMEI sabab bloklangan qurilma bo‘yicha nima qilish kerak
records.answer: Departament FAQi IMEI-kodni UZIMEI tizimida ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazib, ro‘yxatdan o‘tgach qurilmani qayta yoqishni tavsiya qiladi. Ushbu amaliy ketma-ketlikning joriy rasmiy tasdig‘i kutilmoqda.

official_sources.note: The accessible current page does not confirm this specific departmental procedure; human source review remains required.

records.question: Eski avtomatik ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan klon yoki aniqlanmagan IMEI raqamga bog‘langan bo‘lsa nima qilinadi?
question_variants: Eski avtomatik ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan klon yoki aniqlanmagan IMEI raqamga bog‘langan bo‘lsa nima qilinadi
records.answer: Departament FAQi 2019-yildagi avtomatik ro‘yxatdan o‘tish davriga oid maxsus raqam-bog‘lash tartibini tasvirlaydi va raqamni o‘zgartirish uchun ro‘yxatga oluvchiga murojaat qilishni ko‘rsatadi. Ushbu tarixiy tartibning amaldagi holati tasdiqlanmagan.

official_sources.note: The accessible current page does not confirm this specific departmental procedure; human source review remains required.

records.question: Telefon yo‘qolgan yoki o‘g‘irlangan bo‘lsa nima qilish kerak?
question_variants: Telefon yo‘qolgan yoki o‘g‘irlangan bo‘lsa nima qilish kerak
records.answer: Huquqni muhofaza qiluvchi organga ariza bilan murojaat qiling va qurilmaning IMEI-kodini saqlab qo‘ying. Departament FAQi arizada ishlab chiqaruvchi, model va IMEI ma’lumotlarini ko‘rsatishni tavsiya qiladi; aniq ariza talablari vakolatli organda tekshirilishi kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — Stolen phone and the UZIMEI database
official_sources.note: The current RTMC notice supports reporting theft to law enforcement and retaining the IMEI, but does not specify every application field.

records.question: Bojsiz me’yordan ortiq olib kirilgan qurilma IMEI-kodi qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladi?
question_variants: Bojsiz me’yordan ortiq olib kirilgan qurilma IMEI-kodi qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladi
records.answer: Bojsiz me’yor oshirilgan holatda bojxona rasmiylashtiruvi va tegishli to‘lovlardan keyin bojxona kirim orderi asosida IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladi. Amaldagi limit va summalarni Bojxona qo‘mitasining joriy manbasidan tekshiring.

official_sources.page_title: Customs Committee — IMEI customs registration check
official_sources.note: The current Customs service exposes IMEI registration linked to a customs import order.

records.question: JSHSHIR nima?
question_variants: JSHSHIR nima
records.answer: JSHSHIR — jismoniy shaxsning 14 ta raqamdan iborat shaxsiy identifikatsiya raqami.

official_sources.note: The current page defines JSHSHIR as a fourteen-digit personal identification number.

records.question: TAC kodi qurilma turiga mos kelmasa nima qilish kerak?
question_variants: TAC kodi qurilma turiga mos kelmasa nima qilish kerak
records.answer: Departament FAQiga ko‘ra, TAC ma’lumotlari haqiqiy qurilma turiga mos kelmasa, tuzatish uchun ishlab chiqaruvchiga murojaat qilish talab qilinishi mumkin. Aniq qurilma toifasi va amaldagi tartib bo‘yicha rasmiy tasdiq kutilmoqda.

official_sources.note: The accessible current page does not confirm this specific departmental procedure; human source review remains required.

records.question: Mobil qurilmaning IMEI-kodini ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish uchun kim javobgar?
question_variants: Mobil qurilmaning IMEI-kodini ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish uchun kim javobgar
records.answer: Sotish uchun olib kirilgan qurilma bo‘yicha javobgarlik import qiluvchi tadbirkorlik subyektiga tegishli. Shaxsiy olib kirilgan qurilma bo‘yicha ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishni uni olib kirgan shaxs amalga oshiradi.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — Check the IMEI code before buying a phone
official_sources.note: The current RTMC notice confirms importer responsibility for devices brought in for sale.

records.question: Fuqaroligi bo‘lmagan shaxs IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda qaysi hujjatdan foydalanadi?
question_variants: Fuqaroligi bo‘lmagan shaxs IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazishda qaysi hujjatdan foydalanadi
records.answer: Fuqaroligi bo‘lmagan shaxs belgilangan tartibda berilgan biometrik harakatlanish hujjati ma’lumotlaridan foydalanishi mumkin.

official_sources.note: The current page states that stateless persons may use the prescribed biometric travel document.

records.question: SIM-karta almashtirilsa IMEI qayta ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladimi?
question_variants: SIM-karta almashtirilsa IMEI qayta ro‘yxatdan o‘tkaziladimi
records.answer: Departament FAQi IMEI-kod SIM-karta almashtirilishidan qat’i nazar bir marta ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazilishini bildiradi. Ushbu qoida joriy rasmiy sahifada aniq tasdiqlanmagan.

official_sources.note: The accessible current page does not confirm this specific departmental procedure; human source review remains required.

records.question: Jismoniy shaxs uchun ilk tarmoq hodisasidan 30 kun ichidagi IMEI tarifi qancha?
question_variants: Jismoniy shaxs uchun ilk tarmoq hodisasidan 30 kun ichidagi IMEI tarifi qancha
records.answer: Joriy UZIMEI tarif sahifasida rezident va norezident jismoniy shaxslar uchun ilk tarmoq hodisasidan 30 kalendar kun ichidagi tarif 82 400 so‘m, ya’ni BHMning 20 foizi sifatida ko‘rsatilgan. Bu tarif chegarasi ro‘yxatdan o‘tish huquqiy muddatini talqin qilmaydi.

official_sources.note: The current tariff page displays the same applicant class, amount, percentage, and tariff boundary.

records.question: Jismoniy shaxs uchun ilk tarmoq hodisasidan 30 kundan keyingi IMEI tarifi qancha?
question_variants: Jismoniy shaxs uchun ilk tarmoq hodisasidan 30 kundan keyingi IMEI tarifi qancha
records.answer: Joriy UZIMEI tarif sahifasida rezident va norezident jismoniy shaxslar uchun 30 kalendar kundan keyingi tarif 103 000 so‘m, ya’ni BHMning 25 foizi sifatida ko‘rsatilgan. Bu tarif chegarasi ro‘yxatdan o‘tish huquqiy muddatini talqin qilmaydi.

official_sources.note: The current tariff page displays the same applicant class, amount, percentage, and tariff boundary.

records.question: Import qiluvchi uchun IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish tarifi qancha?
question_variants: Import qiluvchi uchun IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish tarifi qancha
records.answer: Joriy UZIMEI tarif sahifasida import qiluvchi uchun tarif 82 400 so‘m, ya’ni BHMning 20 foizi sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.

official_sources.note: The current tariff page displays the same applicant class, amount, percentage, and tariff boundary.

records.question: Mahalliy ishlab chiqaruvchi uchun IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish tarifi qancha?
question_variants: Mahalliy ishlab chiqaruvchi uchun IMEI ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazish tarifi qancha
records.answer: Joriy UZIMEI tarif sahifasida mahalliy ishlab chiqaruvchi uchun tarif 41 200 so‘m, ya’ni BHMning 10 foizi sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.

official_sources.note: The current tariff page displays the same applicant class, amount, percentage, and tariff boundary.

records.question: Chet el SIM-kartasidan roumingda foydalanilganda IMEI tarifi qancha?
question_variants: Chet el SIM-kartasidan roumingda foydalanilganda IMEI tarifi qancha
records.answer: Joriy UZIMEI tarif sahifasida norezident chet el SIM-kartasidan rouming rejimida foydalanganda tarif 0 so‘m deb ko‘rsatilgan.

official_sources.note: The current tariff page displays the same applicant class, amount, percentage, and tariff boundary.

records.question: Qaysi operatorlar GSM standarti bo‘yicha faoliyat olib boradi?
question_variants: Qaysi operatorlar GSM standarti bo‘yicha faoliyat olib boradi
records.answer: Rasmiy MNP manbasida Beeline, Mobi.uz, Ucell, UZTELECOM va Humans GSM operatorlari sifatida ko‘rsatilgan. Operatorlar ro‘yxati vaqtga bog‘liq bo‘lgani uchun ko‘rib chiqish sanasida qayta tekshirilishi kerak.

official_sources.page_title: MNP.UZ — Official launch of number portability
official_sources.note: The official MNP publication lists the five GSM operators and confirms preservation of the subscriber number.

records.question: Operator almashtirilganda telefon raqami saqlanadimi?
question_variants: Operator almashtirilganda telefon raqami saqlanadimi
records.answer: MNP xizmati orqali operator almashtirilganda abonent raqami, jumladan uning operator kodi, saqlanadi.

official_sources.page_title: MNP.UZ — Official launch of number portability
official_sources.note: The official MNP publication lists the five GSM operators and confirms preservation of the subscriber number.

records.question: CDMA raqamini MNP orqali ko‘chirish mumkinmi?
question_variants: CDMA raqamini MNP orqali ko‘chirish mumkinmi
records.answer: Joriy MNP qoidalariga ko‘ra xizmat faqat GSM mobil aloqa operatorlari abonentlari uchun taqdim etiladi; CDMA raqamlari ushbu xizmat doirasiga kirmaydi.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.

records.question: Operatorni qayta almashtirish uchun qancha vaqt o‘tishi kerak?
question_variants: Operatorni qayta almashtirish uchun qancha vaqt o‘tishi kerak
records.answer: Operatorni cheklanmagan marta almashtirish mumkin, ammo oldingi ko‘chirishdan keyin kamida 30 kalendar kun o‘tishi kerak.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.

records.question: Raqam ko‘chirilganda balansdagi mablag‘ ham o‘tadimi?
question_variants: Raqam ko‘chirilganda balansdagi mablag‘ ham o‘tadimi
records.answer: Balans yangi operatorga ko‘chirilmaydi. Qoldiq mablag‘ni qaytarish yoki ishlatish masalasini oldingi operator bilan hal qilish kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — How to change operator while keeping the number
official_sources.note: The current RTMC guidance supports the stated MNP eligibility, debt, document, balance, or timing condition.

records.question: Abonent raqamini ko‘chirish jarayoni qancha davom etadi?
question_variants: Abonent raqamini ko‘chirish jarayoni qancha davom etadi
records.answer: Departament FAQi barcha shartlar bajarilganda jarayon ko‘p vaqt olmasligini bildiradi, biroq qat’iy muddat bermaydi. Amaldagi kafolatlangan muddat bo‘yicha rasmiy tasdiq kutilmoqda; bu yozuv aniq yakunlanish vaqtini va’da qilmaydi.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: MNP arizasidagi shaxsiy ma’lumotlar mos bo‘lishi kerakmi?
question_variants: MNP arizasidagi shaxsiy ma’lumotlar mos bo‘lishi kerakmi
records.answer: Raqamni ko‘chirish uchun arizadagi ma’lumotlar oldingi operatordagi raqam egasi ma’lumotlariga mos bo‘lishi kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — How to change operator while keeping the number
official_sources.note: The current RTMC guidance supports the stated MNP eligibility, debt, document, balance, or timing condition.

records.question: Oldingi operator oldidagi qarzdorlik MNPga ta’sir qiladimi?
question_variants: Oldingi operator oldidagi qarzdorlik MNPga ta’sir qiladimi
records.answer: Raqamni ko‘chirishdan oldin oldingi operator oldidagi qarzdorlik bartaraf etilgan bo‘lishi kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — How to change operator while keeping the number
official_sources.note: The current RTMC guidance supports the stated MNP eligibility, debt, document, balance, or timing condition.

records.question: Bajarilmagan shartnoma majburiyati MNPga ta’sir qiladimi?
question_variants: Bajarilmagan shartnoma majburiyati MNPga ta’sir qiladimi
records.answer: Departament FAQi oldingi operator bilan shartnoma bo‘yicha bajarilmagan majburiyat mavjudligini ko‘chirishga to‘sqinlik qiluvchi holat sifatida ko‘rsatadi. Ushbu shartning joriy rasmiy tasdig‘i kutilmoqda.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: Raqam muvaffaqiyatli ko‘chirilgani qanday bildiriladi?
question_variants: Raqam muvaffaqiyatli ko‘chirilgani qanday bildiriladi
records.answer: Yangi operator raqam muvaffaqiyatli ko‘chirilgani haqida ko‘chirilgan raqamga SMS yuboradi.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.

records.question: Jismoniy shaxs MNP uchun qaysi hujjatni taqdim etadi?
question_variants: Jismoniy shaxs MNP uchun qaysi hujjatni taqdim etadi
records.answer: Jismoniy shaxs raqamni rasmiylashtirishda ishlatilgan shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjatni taqdim etadi.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — How to change operator while keeping the number
official_sources.note: The current RTMC guidance supports the stated MNP eligibility, debt, document, balance, or timing condition.

records.question: Yuridik shaxs MNP uchun qaysi ma’lumotni taqdim etadi?
question_variants: Yuridik shaxs MNP uchun qaysi ma’lumotni taqdim etadi
records.answer: Departament FAQiga ko‘ra, yuridik shaxs tashkilotning STIRini taqdim etadi. Ushbu talabning amaldagi rasmiy tasdig‘i kutilmoqda.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: MNP arizasi ma’lumotlar mos kelmagani uchun rad etilsa nima qilinadi?
question_variants: MNP arizasi ma’lumotlar mos kelmagani uchun rad etilsa nima qilinadi
records.answer: Departament FAQi oldingi operatordagi ma’lumotlarni tuzatib, keyin arizani qayta topshirishni tavsiya qiladi. Joriy rasmiy sahifa ushbu tuzatish ketma-ketligini ochiq tasdiqlamaydi.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: MNP arizasi qarzdorlik sabab rad etilsa nima qilinadi?
question_variants: MNP arizasi qarzdorlik sabab rad etilsa nima qilinadi
records.answer: Oldingi operator oldidagi qarzdorlikni bartaraf etib, keyin ko‘chirish uchun qayta ariza berish kerak.

official_sources.page_title: RTMC — How to change operator while keeping the number
official_sources.note: The current RTMC guidance supports the stated MNP eligibility, debt, document, balance, or timing condition.

records.question: MNP arizasi 30 kunlik interval sabab rad etilsa nima qilinadi?
question_variants: MNP arizasi 30 kunlik interval sabab rad etilsa nima qilinadi
records.answer: Oldingi ko‘chirishdan kamida 30 kun to‘lishini kutib, keyin arizani qayta topshirish kerak.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.

records.question: MNP arizasi raqam bloklangani uchun rad etilsa nima qilinadi?
question_variants: MNP arizasi raqam bloklangani uchun rad etilsa nima qilinadi
records.answer: Departament FAQi avvalgi operatorda raqam blokini bartaraf etib, keyin arizani qayta topshirishni tavsiya qiladi. Blok sababi va yechimi case-specific bo‘lgani uchun rasmiy operator tekshiruvi talab qilinadi.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: Boshqa shaxs nomidagi raqamni ko‘chirish uchun kim ariza bera oladi?
question_variants: Boshqa shaxs nomidagi raqamni ko‘chirish uchun kim ariza bera oladi
records.answer: Departament FAQiga ko‘ra, arizani raqam egasi yoki ishonchnoma asosidagi vakil berishi mumkin. Vakolat hujjatiga qo‘yiladigan amaldagi talablar rasmiy manbada tasdiqlanishi kerak.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: Raqamni boshqa shaxs nomiga qanday qayta rasmiylashtirish mumkin?
question_variants: Raqamni boshqa shaxs nomiga qanday qayta rasmiylashtirish mumkin
records.answer: Departament FAQi ikki abonent tegishli hujjatlar bilan operator ofisiga birga murojaat qilishini, shaxsan qatnasha olmagan tomon uchun esa ishonchnoma qo‘llanishi mumkinligini bildiradi. Joriy operator talablari tasdiqlanishi kerak.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: Oldingi operator oldidagi rouming qarzi xizmat blokiga sabab bo‘lsa nima qilinadi?
question_variants: Oldingi operator oldidagi rouming qarzi xizmat blokiga sabab bo‘lsa nima qilinadi
records.answer: Departament FAQi oldingi operatorga murojaat qilib rouming qarzini bartaraf etishni ko‘rsatadi. Bloklashning huquqiy va shartnomaviy asosi case-specific bo‘lgani uchun rasmiy operator yoki vakolatli xodim tekshiruvi zarur.

official_sources.note: The current public page lists the relevant FAQ question but does not expose its answer in accessible page content.

records.question: MNP uchun ariza qaysi operatorga beriladi?
question_variants: MNP uchun ariza qaysi operatorga beriladi
records.answer: Raqamni ko‘chirish uchun abonent o‘tmoqchi bo‘lgan yangi operatorga murojaat qilib, belgilangan arizani to‘ldiradi. Murojaat kanalining joriy variantlarini yangi operator yoki rasmiy MNP manbasidan tekshiring.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.

records.question: MNP xizmati narxi qanday belgilanadi?
question_variants: MNP xizmati narxi qanday belgilanadi
records.answer: MNP xizmatining narxi operatorga qarab farq qilishi mumkin. Departament FAQi uni yangi shartnoma tuzilganda yangi operatorga to‘lanadigan bir martalik to‘lov sifatida tasvirlaydi; ushbu qo‘shimcha to‘lov tafsilotlari alohida tasdiqlanishi kerak.

official_sources.note: The current page confirms that the fee varies by operator, but does not confirm every payment-contract detail in the departmental wording.

records.question: MNP jarayonida yangi SIM-karta beriladimi?
question_variants: MNP jarayonida yangi SIM-karta beriladimi
records.answer: Yangi operator arizani qabul qilib shartnoma tuzgach, tanlangan tarif rejasiga ulangan yangi SIM-kartani beradi.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.

records.question: MNP.UZ nima?
question_variants: MNP.UZ nima
records.answer: MNP.UZ — GSM abonentiga telefon raqami va operator kodini saqlagan holda boshqa mobil operatorga o‘tish imkonini beruvchi xizmat.

official_sources.note: The current MNP page supports the stated portability rule or service step.
